<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 7:23">Targ. Y. Ex. VII, 23</cite> (h. text <he>ויפן</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01162"><he>פָּנָה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 24:4">Targ. I Sam. XXIV, 4</cite>; a. e.—Y. Dem. VI, 25ᵈ bot. <he>צ׳ לדן וצ׳ לדן</he> both conditions are required.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 1:1:8">Y. Ḥag. I, 76ᵃ</cite> top <he>הוי צ׳ לההוא וכ׳</he> therefore we need the opinion of &c.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 3:3:8">Y. Shebi. III, 34ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>דאזיל ליה לצוֹרְכֵה</he> who goes out to ease his bowels.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 2:1:8">Y. Peah II, beg., 16ᵈ</cite> [read] <he>מכיון דתנינן דרך היחיד דרך הרבים מה צ׳ אתא מימר לך וכ׳</he> (v. Asheri to <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 2:1">Peah II, 1</cite>) since the Mishnah mentions private roads, what need was there to add ‘and public roads’? It is to tell thee &c.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 2:1">Ib.</cite> [read:] <he>לא צ׳ אלא אי קדשה … אי לא קידשה</he> it was only necessary to discuss, whether or not he sanctified it as the share of the poor &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 7:8:2">Y. Pes. VII, 34ᵈ</cite> sq. <he>לא צ׳ דלא אמר וכ׳</he> it is needless to say (it is self-evident) that not (that we do not listen to him), and if he says …, we surely do not &c. Ib. II, end, 29ᶜ <he>לא צ׳ דלא הכהנים וכ׳</he> it is self-evident that not (that they dare not use tepid water), but how about the priests themselves, dare they &c.? <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:8:4">Y. Ber. II, 5ᵇ</cite> bot. (on the text <cite ref="Song of Songs 6:2">Cant. VI, 2</cite>) <he>לא צ׳ אלא דודי ירד לגנו לרעות בגנים</he> there would have been no need to say any more than ‘my beloved went to his garden to feed in the gardens’ (leaving out <he>לערוגות הבשם</he>).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 5:1:3">Y. Succ. V, beg. 55ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Jonah 1:3">Jon. I, 3</cite>) <he>לא צ׳ דילא וירד עכו</he> it ought not to read otherwise than ‘he went down to Acco’ (the nearest harbor to Zarephath, why, then, does it say, he went to Japho?); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 550">Yalk. Jon. 550</cite> <he>לא צורבת דלא כתיב וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.); a. fr.—V. <cite ref="R00774"><he>צְרִיךְ</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>צוֹרְכִין</he>, <he>צוֹרְכַיָּא</he>, <he>צוֹרְכֵי</he>.
